markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (69%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Benign · Careful review
Tier 1 simulated frozen section where the 90% conformal set cannot separate InSitu from Benign [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 69%, Benign 28%, Invasive 2%, Normal 1% (ECE 5%) | Favors InSitu; Benign remains plausible |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% target; 90% test coverage) | Cannot separate InSitu from Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 100% OOD, 12/12 tiles (AUROC 70%) [F6] | Reliable input; atypical OOD distance |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class (true) | Both independent backbones agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu (84%–87% similarity) [F5] | Nearest reference cases match InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 8, 10) · context · Above-typical score (1.11, contribution -0.54) [F2]; AI spot check 8/20 · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.31, contribution -0.35) opposes invasion [F3]; spot check 12/20 · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 4, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable score (1.40, contribution +0.31) favors invasion [F4]; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 11) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (0.31, contribution -0.29) opposes invasion; spot check 19/20 · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable score (1.73, contribution +0.28) favors invasion; spot check 3/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 spans 0); case leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Benign mimicry: contrast case BACH_0230 (83% similar, Benign) differs chiefly in unreliable mitoses and weak lymphocyte scores.
- Unsampled lesion or frozen-section artifact: deeper levels drafted to clarify atypia/InSitu; stains blocked on simulated frozen sections.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 5, 9**: Assess duct-confined atypia (InSitu vs Benign); ignore unreliable necrosis scores (region 5 risk 18%).
2. **Regions 4, 8, 10**: Inspect highest-risk region 8 (23% risk), lymphocytic infiltrate, and manually check unreliable mitoses.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 8, 9**: Verify superior (215 um), medial (323 um), and inferior (323 um) margins [F7].

found: The CONCH–MUSK row names InSitu, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
OOD percentile 1 means this image is farther from the calibration images than 100% of them (atypical), not 'typical'.
